notes.description: The medium-range workhorse: steady climb, real bullet travel. Learn it and it never lets you down.
notes.range: Best within 25 m: full damage, 6 body shots. Down to 60 % (10 shots) by 70 m; reaches 500 m. Standard ballistics: by impact speed, the same distances.
notes.model: The owner's own AK-47 Modular Assault Rifle (Meshy, owned, 2026-11-27; content/guns.json), sharper copies in your own hands at Medium and High; it replaced the 3DModelsCC0 AK-47. The kit rifle is the fallback.
notes.design: Benchmark D: high velocity, visible long-range travel and drop, predictable vertical climb, a medium-range workhorse.
